address: Club Vista Mare, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
bio: This Lebanese seafood restaurant features fishing paraphernalia like ropes, anchors and even a boat – as well as a beautiful terrace with a great view of the beach. Ask for a table on the sand for a beach day experience, then head to the fresh fish counter to choose what you’d like to eat; the simple yet classically cooked dishes let the ingredients speak for themselves, complemented by a blend of aromatic herbs and spices....
